notVerified: The deployed Cloudflare edge. functions/fetch.js ran as its real handlers dispatched in Node (undici Request/Response — the technique tests/e2e-network.cjs uses). The workerd/Pages runtime (edge buffering, client-disconnect propagation, header handling at the edge) was not exercised.
HTTPS / TLS and HTTP/2 / HTTP/3: the stand-in is plain HTTP/1.1 on loopback.

Real MCP servers: the stand-in answers each POST with exactly one response for the request id. Servers that send notifications or server-initiated requests before the response, batches, or several events per stream were not exercised.
The standalone server-to-client stream (GET <endpoint> with text/event-stream) and session termination (DELETE <endpoint>).
A bearer resolved through the C3 credentials port ($NAME in the Authorization header, redirect:"manual", echo redaction): the probes send a literal TEST bearer header.
Protocol-version negotiation failures (400/404 on MCP-Protocol-Version), 429/retry, resumability via Last-Event-ID, OAuth.
Browsers other than the Chrome recorded in environment.chrome.
